root_cause.text: The error handling paths in xhci_disable_slot() free the command structure with kfree() instead of xhci_free_command(), which leaks the completion structure that was allocated by xhci_alloc_command() when the second argument is true.
root_cause.evidence: The patch replaces two kfree(command) calls with xhci_free_command(xhci, command) in the error paths. The CVE description states that xhci_alloc_command() allocates both command and completion structures, and the original code only used kfree(), causing a leak. The commit message confirms: "Use xhci_free_command() instead of kfree(). xhci_free_command() correctly frees both the command structure and the associated completion structure."
